prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Chrome Penthouse", the luxurious penthouse of three rich sisters high above the clouds, interior seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: white marble and pale parquet floors, thin interior walls with door openings. It is night: the rooms are dim, lit by cool moonlight, small golden lamps and city glow.
TOP STRIP: three small balconies with glass railings and a view of clouds and distant city lights: left balcony with BLUE cushions and blue flowers, center balcony with RED cushions and red roses, right balcony with GREEN plants.
TOP ROW behind the balconies: three bedrooms side by side, separated by thin walls with door gaps: left bedroom all in blue with a canopy bed and a big gold-framed vanity mirror (most eye-catching spot); center bedroom all in red with a round bed; right bedroom all in green with a bed among potted plants.
LEFT SIDE below: a library with tall dark wooden bookshelves, a reading chair and a globe.
CENTER: a big salon with white leather sofas around a glass coffee table, a crystal chandelier seen from above, a grand piano, one sofa holds a small dog bed cushion.
RIGHT SIDE: an entrance hall with a tall double front door at the right edge, a wall-mounted house intercom phone with a small screen, a coat rack and a console table.
BOTTOM ROW: a service corridor: bottom left a steel freight elevator door, next to it a laundry room with washing machines and an open laundry chute hatch in the wall; bottom right a dark alcove with drone charging docks glowing red.
Small stuff: vases, art on pedestals, rugs, a champagne cart.
Light: night, dim, moonlight blue, warm golden lamp pools, red standby LEDs.
